title: Where to find the Meross HomeKit setup code
description: Meross shows the HomeKit setup code in its app under Device Settings, Device Info, and documents a factory mode route for a device deleted from iOS.
lede: Meross is one of the few makers with a written recovery. The code is in the app while the device is set up there, and there is a route back for a device that was removed.

rows.text: Device Settings, Device Info, HomeKit setup code, for a device that is set up in the Meross app. Android users can set the device up in the app and read the code at the same place.

rows.term: New device, or deleted on iOS
rows.text: Meross: factory reset by holding the power or reset button for 5 seconds, keep the device in factory mode for 20 minutes, add it in the Meross app as the Basic Version, then read the HomeKit code on the product settings page.
Meross support, with the Amazon order invoice and the accessory's original Wi-Fi name, Meross_XX_XXXX.
Where the Meross app shows a Matter code is not documented by Meross; only user reports exist. For a Meross Matter device already in an ecosystem, use that ecosystem's sharing step.
